vachanas.kannada:
ಒತ್ತೆಯ ಹಿಡಿದು ಮತ್ತೊತ್ತೆಯ ಹಿಡಿಯೆ.
ಹಿಡಿದಡೆ ಬತ್ತಲೆ ನಿಲಿಸಿ ಕೊಲುವರಯ್ಯಾ.
ವ್ರತಹೀನನನರಿದು ಬೆರೆದಡೆ
ಕಾದ ಕತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈ ಕಿವಿ ಮೂಗ ಕೊಯ್ವರಯ್ಯಾ. ಒಲ್ಲೆನೊಲ್ಲೆ ಬಲ್ಲೆನಾಗಿ,
ನಿಮ್ಮಾಣೆ ನಿರ್ಲಜ್ಜೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
otteya hiḍidu mattotteya hiḍiye.
hiḍidaḍe battale nilisi koluvarayyā.
vratahīnananaridu beredaḍe
kāda kattiyalli kai kivi mūga koyvarayyā. ollenolle ballenāgi,
nim'māṇe nirlajjēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Taking one pledge only to take up another,
If one does so, they will strip him bare and put him to death.
If, knowing one to have abandoned his vow, you still associate with him,
They would cut off your hands, ears, and nose with a red-hot sword.
Knowing this well, I shall never do so—
This is my solemn vow before You, O Nirlajjēśvara.
